headline: Import growth, export decline and cancellation of benefits. What problems are Uzbekistan's flower growers facing?
summary: Flower imports into Uzbekistan rose 39%, while domestic producers reported lower exports, higher production costs, foreign competition and cancelled tariff exemptions. They asked for duties to be reviewed.
why: Import competition and tariff policy shape domestic horticulture margins and trade balances in agricultural exporters and importers.
original_headline: Import o‘sishi, eksport qisqarishi va imtiyozlarning bekor qilinishi. O‘zbekiston gulchilari qanday muammolarga duch kelmoqda?
